# Been There, Hauled That

> Junk removal in Eagan and the South Metro of the Twin Cities, Minnesota. 10-20% of every job goes to one local homeless shelter or dog rescue, and customers get a photo and video of who their job helped.

- Service area: Eagan, Burnsville, Apple Valley, Lakeville, Farmington, Shakopee and Edina
- Services: furniture, appliances, garage and basement cleanouts, estate and move-out cleanouts, yard debris, light construction debris
- Quotes: free, up front, from a photo. Call/text: (612) 735-5424 · Email: fzewdu98@gmail.com · Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596381343566
- Payment: cash or payment app
